[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-2b[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]bob randomize: bulk re-roll of due prioritized tasks[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`bob randomize` re-rolls every due P1–P4 Obsidian task to its own [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]random date inside that task's configured priority window. Each [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]touched note is written once, with the new date, Blocked status, a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]🎲 Schedule Log entry, and status grouping applied together. The [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]result is published as exactly one scoped `bob randomize` commit, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]taken between two vault-sync cycles under the shared maintenance [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]lock. The command also has a reproducible dry-run preview, polished[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]human output, and a stable JSON contract.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202609/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]bob_randomize.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/bob_randomize.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-2b[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-2b/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pure randomize planner and shared task-field helpers[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]planner[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]planner: lift inline-field parsing into a shared task_fields module; add[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]priority level lookups, seed mixing, the randomize Schedule Log reason [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and insertion, and hooks helper exposure; build the pure randomize_plan [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]module that turns note snapshots into per-note postimages, a reroll [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]list, skip reasons, and load data. Includes exhaustive unit tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Lock wait, scoped commit, sync report, and writer reuse[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]plumbing[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]plumbing: add a bounded lock wait and a scoped path commit helper to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ob.rs, a structured report variant of the in-process vault-sync cycle, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and a tool-name parameter for the guarded writer so recovery records [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]land under bob-cli/randomize. Existing hooks, nightly, and vault-sync [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]behavior stays unchanged.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob randomize command, output, and integration tests[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]command[dim] · [dim][/dim]after planner, plumbing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]command: add the clap CLI and runner registration; orchestrate lock, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pre-sync, plan and guarded apply with retries, scoped commit, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]post-sync; render the human and JSON outputs and exit codes; add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tests/randomize.rs integration coverage, including git, conflicts, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]determinism, and task-status-hooks parity.[/#D7D7AF]
